summaries.title: Towards Human-like Multimodal Conversational Agent by Generating Engaging Speech
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Towards Human-like Multimodal Conversational Agent** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：We propose a human-like agent that generates speech responses based on conversation mood and responsive style information。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To achieve this, we build a novel MultiSensory Conversation dataset focused on speech to enable agents to generate natural speech。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（The source code is available in）。
